message: So, the other day I was chatting with my neighbor about fire safety, and I couldn't help but feel a bit smug. Remember that time I insisted we all test our smoke alarms? Well, hers was beeping a low battery warning, and she hadn’t even noticed! 😅 It's those little things that slip our minds, but staying on top of smoke alarms and having an escape plan isn’t just smart—it’s essential. Just a friendly reminder to check those alarms and have a plan in place. You never know when you might need it, right?
